decision_note: Brno pre-seed/seed VC fund (EUR 16m / CZK 400m) initiated by the regional innovation agency JIC, launched 7 April 2026; first investment FaceUp (Series A, May 2026).

funds.name: JIC Ventures (JIC Ventures 2 a.s., osoba rizikového kapitálu)

evidence.quote: Individual investments in projects in deep tech, SaaS, and other advanced technologies may reach up to EUR 1 million.
Fond o objemu 400 milionů korun, který iniciovalo Jihomoravské inovační centrum (JIC), bude investovat do technologických startupů v raných fázích, tedy pre-seed a seed, z Česka a střední Evropy.
It is expected to invest in around 20 companies over the next four years, with individual investments of up to €1 million.
The EUR 16 million fund aims to contribute to the transformation of the Czech economy.
The fund joined a Series A round totalling $5 million, led by Croatian fund Fil Rouge Capital, bringing not only capital but also knowing the company from its very beginnings.

JIC Ventures will focus primarily on startups in the pre-seed and seed stages and plans to invest in around twenty technology companies from Central and Eastern Europe over the next four years, with a natural priority given to the Czech Republic and Slovakia.

analyst_notes: Fund size: EUR 16m (JIC English release) = CZK 400m (CTP release and Lupa); the release says the fund has not yet reached its final close, so the launch event (2026-04-07) is recorded, not a close. Geography stated as CEE 'with a natural priority given to the Czech Republic and Slovakia' (same JIC release). Public flag set because the fund was initiated by the innovation agency JIC (founded by the South Moravian Region, City of Brno and four universities) and the Region is an LP; most fund capital is private (about 40 investors incl. CTP, Česká spořitelna, Jan Barta). The fund vehicle IČO 24320358 (registered 2026-01-05) is matched by name; JIC Ventures, s.r.o. (2015) is the earlier JIC investment vehicle. FaceUp round size is the whole Series A (USD 5m); JIC Ventures' share undisclosed. Website: fund pages are on jic.cz (jicventures.cz returned no content).
